Mr. TONECAT Charm / Keychain $15.00 Add Added! Deboned. Cleaned. Drenched in oil Fuzz à l’Huile is our oily interpretation of the vintage silicon Fuzz Face circuit. Powered by 2x BC108 transistors + Bias adjustable trim . It is tuned somewhere between precision engineering and questionable cooking decisions. The result? Rich, chewy fuzz with a little unpredictability left in the tin. This is not engineering. This is cuisine. Pedal details The Circuit Inspired by vintage silicon Fuzz Face pedals from the late ’60s and early ’70s, Fuzz à l’Huile uses carefully selected silicon transistors to create a boutique fuzz pedal that feels both classic and immediate. Expect: smooth creamy sustain at lower FUZZ settings blooming vintage-style midrange bite saturated harmonic fuzz when fully opened up Responsive, dynamic, and easy to stack with overdrives, boosts, and amp-style pedals. Never thin. Never fizzy. Never boutique-priced. Packed Fresh Each unit comes wrapped in a pantry-inspired polished enclosure with nostalgic tinned-fish artwork — like something discovered behind an old record shop beside expired sardines and jazz records. Affordable enough to throw onto any board. Good enough to stay there permanently. The Controls VOL - Enough output to push your amp straight into flavour territory. FUZZ - From golden crisp to deep-fried sustain. BIAS TRIM POD (inside) - Provide adjustability of your fuzz - tweak to your liking. Don’t believe us? Hear the tone for yourself.
